annotations.title: Draft a reply for a lead

description: Draft a reply for a lead, written the way the coach writes, and put it in the SetLuca review queue, where it waits for the coach to approve it. Drafting again replaces this lead's earlier unapproved draft from this tool. It never sends, whatever the channel's auto-send setting. Optional guidance steers tone or content. Example: call with { leadId, guidance: "keep it short and warm" }.

guidance.description: Optional steer for tone or content of the draft.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when retrying this exact draft.

leadId.description: The lead to draft a reply for.

name: luca_draft_reply
title: Draft a reply for a lead
